review_method: task-bound full-timeline semantic review of the exact 124-frame encoded fallback using every-fourth-frame contact sheets plus original-resolution spot checks; this review covers visible 2-D robot topology only and does not assert inspect-flower action correspondence

ranges.note: The exact encoded fallback retains one connected torso/head and two shoulder-rooted articulated arms throughout the 124-frame interval. Flowers partially occlude the hands but do not create a visible extra limb or ambiguous shoulder root. Action correspondence is evaluated separately against the current hashed control video.
